exactness_contract.definition: D[j] = bits_BF16(E2M1(q[n,k]) * E4M3(s[n,floor(k/16)])); C[n,k] = j. The final weight_scale_2 is not included in D. For finite operands the product is exactly BF16 and equal to current fma.rn.bf16x2(q,s,-0).
exactness_contract.signed_zero: Dictionary identity is raw BF16 bits, keeping +0 and -0 separate. Product sign is q_sign XOR s_sign; current negative-zero addend preserves that sign. Converting D[j] to FP32 must be exact.
exactness_contract.finite_significand_bound: After removing powers of two, finite E2M1 has odd significand at most 3 and finite E4M3 at most 15. Their product has at most 6 significant bits (45); the finite nonzero exponent range is safely normal in BF16. Integer bit construction below is exact.
exactness_contract.accumulation: The consumer must keep the current K-lane assignment, four FP32 FMA chains, ordered lane/warp tree, +0 boundaries, final tensor-scale operation and BF16 publication. Exact replacement weight bits make every FMA identical for every accumulator/input, including nonfinite inputs; no multiplication reassociation is introduced.
exactness_contract.nonfinite_scales: Current selected 181 projection records are marked finite. This does not prove a generic NaN dictionary encoding or full API admission. Nonfinite checkpoint scales require exact native BF16x2 bit-policy admission or fail-closed unsupported representation; keeping a hidden full original owner is not allowed in the memory arithmetic.
exactness_contract.prefill_boundary: A complete owner replacement must preserve the existing Prefill dequantized BF16 operands and reduction path. A changed consumer layout may need bounded conversion scratch. No Prefill implementation or timing is supplied.

cardinality.method: For Gate: form a conservative Cartesian superset of every observed scale code from the frozen complete scale histogram × all 16 q codes. No joint payload scan is needed to prove fit. For Down: use every integer scale code in the frozen min..max interval × all 16 q codes; this is a looser superset.
integer_recipe: n = q2 * (F if E==0 else 8+F); p=(-9 if E==0 else E-10)-1; sign=((q>>3) XOR (s>>7))<<15.
If n==0, result=sign. Otherwise remove factors of two from n and increase p by the same count; b=bit_length(n), exponent=b-1+p.
bits=sign | ((exponent+127)<<7) | ((n-2**(b-1))<<(8-b)); assert b<=8 and -126<=exponent<=127. Count distinct 16-bit results; hash sorted little-endian results.

memory.admission: These are payload arithmetic only. The canonical device allocation is monolithic: savings require resident-loader replanning and typed owner dispatch for every consumer, not cudaFree of holes. At most one bounded host packing buffer may be streamed; transient device original-plus-new full matrices, dictionary layout, startup peak, Graph lifetime and >=8-GiB reserve remain unadmitted. No duplicate full owner is included.

traffic.interpretation: Conditional one-pass no-compression/no-cross-call-residency screen, not measured DRAM traffic, measured hardware peak or an impossibility proof. It grants all nominal bandwidth to code bytes and excludes activation/output/dictionary/compute cost.
traffic.cache_treatment: No full-L2-per-projection credit is assumed. Reusing that amount at every matrix transition is unestablished; overlapping source data and other kernels can evict it. Cache-residency or bandwidth-compression changes would need independent evidence before altering this screen.
traffic.observation: All-128 Gate/Up code payload alone needs 55.7056 ms/round at nominal bandwidth versus current measured 50.9361 ms/round in the long diagnostic. The 53 packed Down code payload alone needs 23.0656 ms versus current 21.1162 ms. This is unfavorable before dictionary lookup, original FMAs and publication; capacity-neutral replacement does not fix the hot-traffic increase.

whole_api_budget.profile_scope: Installed cap3 diagnostic windows omit first draft/entry work and are not whole-API throughput. Short has five M3 and one M4 rounds; long has ten M2 and 95 M3 rounds. Same full weights are traversed once per projection call regardless of M.
whole_api_budget.consequence: No predicted gain is defensible. Long Attention alone cannot meet the all-bucket requirement; eliminating short Attention would move this short window by only about 0.21%. No remaining concrete executor is selected by this assessment.
